text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head over to the school kitchen to
make myself
some food, but when I get
there...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get started! Are you ready?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am! I'm ready for instructions!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Today's theme is... "Surviving for a Week
on
Limited Rations"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So the school's surrounded by zombies
and we
have a limited amount of food...
And we have to
figure out a way to
survive the ordeal?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is all so thrilling! As a princess, I
must learn to
thrive with grace in any
and all situations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess they're playing make-believe?
But I must
say, the premise of a zombie
siege sounds pretty
fun.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
First off, we'll be heading to the school
fields to
find ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! I wasn't expecting to have to
leave the
building and venture outside
so soon. This must
be quite the
emergency situation.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, we need food to live. So if we get
hungry,
then that's an emergency
situation right there!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Such sound reasoning! Very well. Leave
this to
me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess must be prepared to send
zombie
rapscallions flying with a firm
sucker punch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer, great timing! So, um, we
need you to
be a zombie!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How exciting. So a lone zombie has
managed
to infiltrate the academy...
Please, do get after
us!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Don't worry! We won't rough you
up or
anything, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's go! Come on, try and get us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know what's what, I'm cast as a
zombie. I
guess I should start chasing
after them...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I grew all the vegetables from over here to over there, so you can go ahead and harvest them! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
They're all so fresh and plump! I almost
want to
bite right into one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: They are tasty raw, but now is the time for restraint. ☆ Come on, let's harvest them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're both completely absorbed in
their
harvesting. And I'm about to keel
over from
sprinting the whole way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the zombie, what should I do now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Groaning like the zombies I've seen in
video
games, I sprint toward them.
choice_data_list: 根性を見せて追いかける
生き生きと力強く登場する
choice_data_list_en: Show some guts and give chase
Make a lively and powerful entrance

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! Y-you scared me! Wait. You caught up with us already?! That's amazing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Stand back, Akebono! That's not your
trainer,
that's a zombie! Take this, foul
beast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You can't just shove tomatoes in
people's
mouths like that, Kawakami!
Are you okay,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ☆ Looks like our zombie's
hungry, too. All
right, go ahead and eat
your fill!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The other veggies are yummy too. I'm
sure they'll
satisfy even our zombie's
appetite!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! Our food supplies are limited,

remember?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! But it's cruel to leave a
zombie
with an empty tummy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We have to face reality, no matter how
harsh it
may be! Now, let's punch its
lights out—ah, I
mean, let's flee while it's
munching away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'm so sorry, but... goodbye,
zombie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two disappear into the distance. I
try chasing
them with my arms stretched
out in the classic
zombie pose, but end
up alone in the field.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, it looks like this high-stakes
situation was a
learning experience for
Hishi Akebono, so I'll call
this a win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead of acting like a sluggish,
stereotypical
zombie, I make a grand
entrance by jumping out
at them both.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I thought you were supposed to be a zombie, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But you're here acting all lively and
energetic!
Wait, did you get brought
back to life?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, you mustn't let your guard down!
That must
be a super zombie! In other
words, it's been
powered up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What?! But how did it get powered up?!
Did it eat
a bunch of food or
something?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you saying it got stronger by eating my food?! Wow! What kind of food was that?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Don't! You mustn't approach it on your
own!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There's only one option left for us now!
Akebono,
combine your strength with
mine so we can
immobilize this zombie!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, okay! Let's catch it! And grill it!
About
what it ate!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No lousy zombie's going to get the
better of me!
I'll show you my chanko
power!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Take this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono lifts me like I weigh
nothing at all,
and the two giggling
students seal their victory
over me, the
pitiful zombie.
